name: batch-operations
description: Batch Operations – listing, search, filtering and pagination (React + Express)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
